statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail 10 sits in the low band while Stress 47 remains elevated ahead of the 12:30Z claims release; the published danger window spans 12:30Z-15:00Z.
recommendation: The deterministic mapping holds at EA_ON. Tail stays at 10 because the hour since the previous assessment added no amplifier: NQ has traded flat near 29,603 against 29,599 an hour earlier, the overnight range of 29,401.75 to 29,660.50 has been neither extended nor broken, and price sits roughly 60 points below the high rather than pinned against it. The session already contains two completed give-backs, the full 253-point retracement of the post-earnings impulse and the failure at the marginal new high, so mean reversion is functioning on both scales. Cross-assets offer no confirmation of a directional squeeze: VIX is 14.89 against a 15.21 close inside a 14.80 to 14.98 range, WTI is 82.44 dollars and Brent 88.49 dollars after three softer sessions, and the most recent published H.15 constant maturities of 2Y 4.17% and 10Y 4.64% sit six to seven basis points below the prior reading. Stress is raised two points to 47 purely because the 12:30Z release is now inside the next hour. The forward path lifts Tail into the watch band only for the 13:00Z and 14:00Z slots covering the cash open and the first full cash hour of Nvidia repricing, and the danger window is kept narrow at 12:30Z-15:00Z. Stress reflects the event stack rather than any observed failure of mean reversion, decays through the U.S. afternoon and rebuilds into Friday's scheduled Jackson Hole keynote.
headline: NQ holds 29,603 in a flat hour with the overnight range unextended: Tail steady at 10, Stress 47 into the 12:30Z claims release
body: Nasdaq-100 September futures trade at 29,603.25 on Yahoo Finance and 29,600.75 on Investing.com, both quotes timed near 11:18Z, up about 313 points or 1.06% against a previous close of 29,289.50. Both references show the same overnight range of 29,401.75 to 29,660.50, with the second source printing a high of 29,662.00. The governing observation is that this hour added nothing. An hour ago price stood near 29,599 after rejecting a marginal new high; since then it has gone essentially nowhere, the range has been neither extended upward nor broken downward, and price sits roughly 60 points below the session high and about 200 points above the low. That is the structural opposite of the persistent no-retracement path the Tail score measures, so Tail is held at 10. The session's directional anchor remains Nvidia's second-quarter fiscal 2027 report of 96.2 billion dollars in revenue, up 106% year over year, with data-centre revenue of 89.0 billion dollars, GAAP diluted earnings of 2.46 dollars, non-GAAP diluted earnings of 2.22 dollars and third-quarter guidance of 108.0 billion dollars plus or minus 2%. The shares are indicated up roughly 7% premarket, with Salesforce and CrowdStrike also higher after their own results, and current reporting attributes the roughly 1% gain in Nasdaq-100 futures to that combination. A gap that has already been retraced twice is a repricing rather than a one-way path. Cross-asset evidence remains uniformly calm and unaligned. VIX is 14.89, down 0.32 points or 2.10% from a 15.21 close, inside a narrow 14.80 to 14.98 range. WTI is 82.44 dollars, up 0.25%, and Brent is 88.49 dollars, up 0.74%, with crude trading around 82 dollars after three consecutive lower sessions. The most recent published H.15 constant-maturity readings are 4.17% for the two-year and 4.64% for the ten-year, six and seven basis points below the prior day, and current reporting describes the ten-year a further two basis points lower in early trade. Easing yields, a mid-14s volatility index and soft energy do not constitute an aligned amplifier stack. The near-term calendar is why Stress is raised two points to 47. Initial and continuing jobless claims, the advance goods trade balance and advance wholesale inventories all release at 12:30Z, now inside the next hour and not yet published at assessment time; the U.S. cash open follows at 13:30Z and brings the first cash repricing of Nvidia's results; Kansas City Fed indices print at 15:00Z and a seven-year note auction settles at 17:00Z. Fed Chair Warsh delivers his first Jackson Hole keynote at 14:00Z on Friday, confirmed for 10:00 a.m. Eastern. Consistent with the standing contract these are checkpoints that raise Stress and reduce Confidence rather than automatic Tail blocks, and none of their outcomes is treated as already known. The published danger window is deliberately narrow at 12:30Z to 15:00Z, covering the claims release and the opening sequence only. Evidence quality is high: two independent futures quotes about twenty minutes old, a live volatility reading, published official constant-maturity yields, current energy prices, verified corporate results and a verified event calendar, which supports Confidence at 88. The shared cross-asset context file available to this assessment carried a collection timestamp more than nine hours old and was therefore treated as stale and excluded; every figure above rests on independently fetched primary sources.

lookbackSummary: Across the past 24 hourly slots Tail moved between 10 and 21 and Stress between 45 and 66, with 21 of 24 hours carrying a published assessment and three hours unavailable. The window covers the pre-Nvidia drift on 26 August, the single watch-band hour at 20:00Z spanning the results release, and the steady decay through the Asian and European sessions as the initial repricing was absorbed. Dominant mode rotated from normal into event/whipsaw around the release and has been mixed since 03:00Z, describing a two-sided range rather than a directional trend.
outlookSummary: The forward path keeps the mapped state at EA_ON for 22 of the next 24 hours and lifts Tail into the watch band only at 13:00Z and 14:00Z, covering the U.S. cash open and the first full cash hour of Nvidia repricing. Stress peaks at 60 across the opening auction, decays through the U.S. afternoon to 40 overnight, then rebuilds toward 52 by the end of the horizon as Friday's scheduled Jackson Hole keynote approaches. Confidence decays from 88 to 57 with distance from the observed evidence. Every forward reading is conditional risk, not an assertion that any future price structure has been observed.

Initial and continuing jobless claims, the advance goods trade balance and advance wholesale inventories all release at 12:30Z inside this slot. Tail is raised conditionally to 16 for a first repricing impulse; the release is a checkpoint, and no post-release structure is treated as observed.

Kansas City Fed manufacturing and composite indices at 15:00Z close the published danger window. Conditional Tail steps back to 16 on the assumption that the opening repricing has retraced at least once and settled into a defined cash range.

No scheduled U.S. release falls in this midday hour, and thinner volume between the opening repricing and the afternoon auction historically favours rotation over extension. Conditional Tail eases to 14 with Stress at 50.
